stem.text: A wire is extended by a tensile force so that its deformation is elastic.
What is meant by elastic deformation?

A.text: The extension of the wire is proportional to the tensile force.

B.text: The extension of the wire is **not** proportional to the tensile force.

C.text: When the tensile force is removed, the wire does **not** return to its original length.

D.text: When the tensile force is removed, the wire returns to its original length.
